scope: Local documentary provenance only. External papers were not independently reread in this subtask.

items.class: hard correctness within a declared conversion
checks: source identity and faithful native decoding
finite metric data, handedness and frame consistency
joint correspondence and actual source physical limits
actual mapped pose and independent FK consistency
items.justification: These determine whether the declared conversion is implemented correctly. The chosen wrist-to-palm anchor remains a mapping convention, not an anatomical equivalence theorem. Numerical tolerances still need explicit provenance.

Introduced as an inference admission check before simulation. No paper-derived numerical rationale is present in the inspected introduction. Current documentation explicitly disclaims an established scientific fidelity margin.
items.metric: mean mapped Shadow fingertip position error relative to native MANO fingertip targets; distinct from fingertip-to-object distance

items.class: project diagnostic measurement scales later retained in a strict claim
items.justification: Earliest located full triple protocol explicitly says bands_are_acceptance_thresholds=false. Later strict rule uses the same scales to state the preservation claim. No universal physical-contact or HUG fidelity tolerance follows.

items.class: researcher-defined strong scientific claim; not validated necessity for practical prediction
items.justification: Zero lost/added same-part band relationships defines strict preservation. Once this claim is chosen, a reliable positive-area counterexample refutes it. Selecting this universal equality claim as the prerequisite for downstream usefulness is a separate research choice.
items.pass_requires: complete required equal-state/domain and orientation coverage, zero mismatch upper bounds, no unresolved required comparisons

items.justification: Added because optimizing mean or aggregate surface loss worsened individual fingertips. Current exact caps preserve each original mapped tip error; they do not require exact native fingertip positions or establish that the inherited error is small enough.
items.history: Earliest constrained solver declared a 10nm numerical allowance. Later feasible solver and current audit use literal baseline caps with no added allowance. Keep versions separate.

items.class: geometric measurement definition plus project numerical eligibility safeguards
items.definition: sign of -dot(hand outward normal,object outward normal)
items.justification: Facing/away is a geometric hemisphere distinction, not an imported angle threshold. Reversal refutes the chosen sign-preservation claim at that eligible site. A matching sign need not imply useful contact, small angle change, force or outcome preservation.
limitations: query-only agreement does not certify an entire surface cell
invalid, tied, buried or missing required features remain unresolved
distance Lipschitz bounds do not bound normals

items.class: project measurement domain and correspondence design
items.native: open anatomical triangle patches labeled by skinning-based proxies
items.target: union of individual per-part collider surfaces, including buried interfaces for unsigned distance
items.justification: These sets differ from a true exposed union boundary and from active simulator contacts. Orientation separately excludes buried/unreliable features. Existing literal-domain counterexamples remain valid under the frozen contract; they cannot silently become physical contact-area claims.

items.class: bounded optimization design; not fidelity margin
items.justification: Historical report explicitly calls 0.35rad and the residual scale implementation choices. Bounds intersect actual source physical limits; source physical limits and the chosen trust region have different roles. A finite failure inside this domain is not global Shadow infeasibility.

items.class: mathematical distance bound conditional on numeric error allowance; conservative evidence procedure
items.justification: Distance to a fixed set is 1-Lipschitz and maximum centroid-to-vertex radius encloses the triangle. The arithmetic epsilon is an engineering assumption, not a formal floating-point certificate. Separate native/target intervals can yield positive mismatch upper bounds for identical ambiguous fields.
items.limits: The existing identity control shows inability to certify PASS in that ambiguous case, not actual mismatch, universal infeasibility or invalidity of definite counterexamples.
